mapper.sql: P.POST_ID, P.MEMBER_ID, P.BOARD_ID, P.TITLE, P.CONTENT, P.CATEGORY, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.IS_BLIND, P.REPORT_COUNT, P.IS_DELETED, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT, M.MEMBER_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, M.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, B.BOARD_NAME, B.IS_ANONYMOUS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_LIKE PL WHERE PL.POST_ID = P.POST_ID) AS LIKE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_COMMENT PC WHERE PC.POST_ID = P.POST_ID AND PC.IS_DELETED = 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT
FROM POST P JOIN MEMBER M ON P.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID JOIN BOARD_TYPE B ON P.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*)
WHERE P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_BLIND = 0
AND P.BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
AND (P.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR P.CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_POST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO POST ( POST_ID, MEMBER_ID, BOARD_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CATEGORY, VIEW_COUNT, IS_BLIND, REPORT_COUNT, IS_DELETED, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{boardId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, 0, 0, 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE POST SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, CATEGORY = #{category}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
